new_scholarship.description: The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program is a ten-month, non-degree Fulbright exchange programme funded by the U.S. Department of State and administered by the Institute of International Education. It brings mid-career professionals from eligible countries to a U.S. host university for graduate-level coursework, a six-week Professional Affiliation, the Humphrey Seminar, a Global Leadership Forum and professional development. The programme pays tuition and fees, a maintenance allowance, sickness and accident coverage, allowances for books and a computer, travel, and a Professional Development allowance.

research_notes.logo: No logo accepted. Clark University's theme serves two SVG marks on cdn.clarku.edu: clark-logo-w-type-r-logo.svg and clark-logo-w-type-w-logo.svg. Both were downloaded and inspected at path-class level. The -w variant is uniformly #fff (all 72 paths) on a transparent background: a white-on-transparent wordmark, rejected outright. The -r variant has three classes: cls-1 #e51f2e (1 path, the outer red badge ring), cls-2 #fff (46 paths) and cls-3 #525150 (8 paths). The 46 white paths include the letterforms forming the Clark University wordmark at y-coordinates 119.65, 127.09, 127.33, 127.91 and 135.8 with x-coordinates from 39 to 373, which is well outside the badge at x 452-591, so the wordmark is white on transparent rather than white on the red badge. Only the red circular badge would be visible on a light card, so this also fails the legibility rule. A third candidate, clark-logo-footer-cta.png (500x74), was fetched as an image but is a plain white field with no visible mark. Standalone logo probes at other theme and upload paths returned connection resets. The stored image was a contact-area photograph on the official domain, not the awarding body's logo.
